title: Rating Symbol Validation
user_story: As a ratings data steward, I want the system to validate rating symbols on entry so that only valid agency-scale ratings are stored.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the agency is MOODYS, the system accepts every symbol on the Moody's-style long-term scale (21 symbols, Aaa to C).
When the agency is FITCH, the system accepts every symbol on the Fitch-style long-term scale (23 symbols, AAA to D, including CCC+, CCC-, RD and D).
A symbol that is valid only on the other agency's scale is rejected with error code RATING_SCALE_MISMATCH (e.g. 'Aa2' submitted for FITCH).
Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before validation. Validation is case-sensitive: 'aa2' or 'bbb' is not a valid symbol.
Unknown or malformed symbols (e.g. 'Aa4', 'AAA+', 'BBB--', empty string) are rejected with error code INVALID_RATING_SYMBOL.
Status codes are accepted but stored with is_rating=false: 'WR' (withdrawn) and 'NR' (not rated) for MOODYS; 'WD' (withdrawn) and 'NR' for FITCH.
